notes.title: Craftimals: Build to the Sun
notes.content:
The Xbox Live Indie Game classic, and original inspiration for [i]Doggo Dig Down[/i], is coming to Steam!

I always saw [i]Doggo Dig Down[/i] as the modern, quintessential version of this game, but I've been asked by a few people now if [i]Craftimals[/i] in its purest form was ever going to come back. Well, here it is!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3172430/Craftimals_Build_to_the_Sun/

I've added new keyboard/mouse controls, changed the music, fixed a few outstanding bugs, and implemented all the standard Steam features, but this is still largely the same game that it was back in 2012.

[i]Craftimals[/i] will be released mid-October and will launch alongside a "Build to the Sun" bundle that includes [i]Doggo Dig Down[/i]. So if you've already purchased [i]Doggo Dig Down[/i], then keep an eye out for the bundle to get a discount.

notes.title: v1.3: Grappling Hooks and More
notes.content:
Version 1.3 represents a long overdue "quality of life" update that makes several adjustments to existing features and adds some cool new stuff. For instance...

[h2]The Grappling Hook:[/h2]

This new ability unlocks at the third power-up in the sky. You can freely switch between the dirtpack and grapple, making it much easier (and much more fun!) to traverse up through the ground.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33345969/82c71fe1c3392bb059de3daf3aac5b52ab1b7443.gif[/img]

[h2]Other Key Changes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Improved movement animations for doggo.
[*] New HUD elements to serve as reminders of which features you've unlocked. These can also be turned off in the pause menu settings.
[*] Better-looking main menu that reflects if Ice Mode is enabled.
[*] Several new sound effects.
[*] Gamepad controls have been updated to utilize the D-pad for toggling hats and grid mode.
[*] Some of the original hats have been restored, so there's now a mix of original and Halloween-themed hats.
[*] Build radius starts out bigger and only needs one upgrade to max out.
[*] Jetpack fuel has been significantly increased.
[*] Carry limit upgrades have been slightly increased.
[*] Heavy blocks have been removed, so there's no longer an underground barrier that requires a power-up to get past.
[/list]

notes.title: Happy Doggo-ween!
notes.content:
All hats in the game have been replaced with new, Halloween-themed hats/costumes. These will remain even after Halloween ends, so there's no rush!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33345969/91e8e6db5ec44687fe376ece770724ee39a2f8cf.png[/img]

Hats are unlocked by finding presents underground. There are nine (spooky) hats in total.

notes.title: v1.2: New Graphics for Linux
notes.content:
[i]Doggo Dig Down[/i] is now up and running on Linux! Only 64-bit versions of Ubuntu are guaranteed, but I'll do my best to support other flavors as they arise.

This update also adds some much needed background visuals throughout the game and improves a few other graphical and audio issues.

The trailer and screenshots have been updated to reflect the new look:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z3Az8vO9bPo

notes.title: v1.1: Ice Mode
notes.content:
Version 1.1 adds a new, optional "Ice Mode" (accessed via the main menu) that makes all blocks slippery and keeps doggo moving. Try it out if you need an extra challenge or just want to goof around! Also in this update:

[list]
[*] Increased incremental carry limits
[*] Smoothed out jumping velocity
[*] Fixed a bug with color selecting
[/list]
